category_title: Verbal students with autistic-like behaviors who engage in skin-picking and have restricted conversational topics
scenario_title: Social initiation with peers during lunch period
minimal_context: Hugh is in the cafeteria during the lunch period, attempting to initiate a conversation with a group of peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Hugh, it is the lunch period. Go ahead and find some peers to eat with and start a conversation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Rubs his eyes and looks around) I am trying to locate peers from anime club or orchestra.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: There is a group of students right over there. Why don't you go over to them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks over and stands near the group of students without disabilities, picking at his arm) Anime club...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You are standing right next to them. Go ahead and talk to them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not initiate to or interact with the peers. Continues to stand near the group while engaging in repetitive face- and arm-picking and finger movements.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Hugh, it is the lunch period. Go ahead and find some peers to eat with and start a conversation.

STUDENT: (Rubs his eyes and looks around) I am trying to locate peers from anime club or orchestra.

TUTOR: There is a group of students right over there. Why don't you go over to them?

STUDENT: (Walks over and stands near the group of students without disabilities, picking at his arm) Anime club...

TUTOR: You are standing right next to them. Go ahead and talk to them.

STUDENT: (Does not initiate to or interact with the peers. Continues to stand near the group while engaging in repetitive face- and arm-picking and finger movements.)

task.content: Initiate to or interact with peers without disabilities
task.learning_goal: Learning to talk to new friends at school

context.materials: Communication books with only a typed conversational opener
context.social_setting: Near groups of students without disabilities

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Trying to locate peers from these groups with whom to eat
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Stood near groups of students without disabilities, but did not initiate to or interact with them

behavior_patterns.condition: During baseline observations in general education classes and lunch
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Engage in repetitive stereotypic behavior, including hand and finger movements, eye rubbing, verbal stereotypy, repetitive handling of objects, and skin picking (face- and arm-picking)

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to converse with peers
